subject: expression: introduce EvalContext to evaluate expression (#49416)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs parent only. Change is a large, mostly-mechanical refactor switching expression evaluation APIs from `sessionctx.Context` to `expression.EvalContext` (a strict subset of `sessionctx.Context`), plus a small planner adjustment for `tidb_decode_key` decoding to use `GetDomainInfoSchema()` (includes session temp tables) instead of `domain.GetDomain()`. Checked the touched planner/privilege adaptations and key expression call paths; no plausible remaining Blocker/High issues found in correctness, SQL semantics, privilege/visibility, transaction/session behavior, or concurrency. Limited later-history scan of the touched files showed no follow-up fix indicating an introduced Blocker/High bug.
